title: AgentFactory Starter Kit Manifest
description: Manifest schema for an AgentFactory starter kit. Validates every kit.json in this repository.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editor tooling.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier; must match the kit's directory name.

version.description: Semantic-ish version of the kit (e.g. 1.0 or 1.2.3).

status.description: Lifecycle status. 'published' means the spec has been validated by a finished build.

id.description: Top-level industry vertical. Group verticals (with the fine-grained industries that roll up to each) are defined in schemas/verticals.json — classify an incoming industry into its group and put the specific industry in subSegment/tags. 'cross-vertical' = applies across all industries.

subSegment.description: Sub-segment within the vertical (e.g. 'mid-market SaaS', 'community health systems').

description.description: One-paragraph description of what the kit does and detail page.

buildLevel.description: Which AWS primitive this kit uses. Drives which infrastructure files exist on disk.

deployTime.description: Rough time from starting the build to a running agent in your account (e.g. '3–5 days').

services.description: AWS services used by the kit. Surfaced as tags on the card.

provider.description: Model provider. 'bedrock' covers Anthropic, Amazon, Meta, Mistral models served via Bedrock.

outcomes.description: Outcomes the kit delivers. Lead with metrics.

multiple.description: ROI multiple shown on the card (e.g. '50–90x').

assumes.description: One-line statement of the assumptions behind the numbers.

triggers.description: Signals or pain points that indicate this kit is a good fit.

disqualifiers.description: Conditions that mean the kit is not a fit.

customerCustomizes.description: What you customize after deployment. Half of the shared-responsibility split.

preBuilt.description: What ships pre-built in the kit. Half of the shared-responsibility split.

sharedResponsibility.description: One-paragraph shared-responsibility statement. Always shown to the reader.

readme.description: Path to README.md (relative to kit root).

agentsMd.description: Path to AGENTS.md (coding-agent contract). Convention: at kit root alongside README.md.

buildSpec.description: Path to build-spec/ directory containing requirements.md, architecture-decisions.md, deployment-spec.md, acceptance-tests.md.

deployScript.description: Path to deploy script (legacy/imported kits only — new kits don't generate this).

iacTemplate.description: Path to IaC template (legacy/imported custom-iac kits only).

harnessConfig.description: Path to harness.json (legacy/imported managed-harness kits only).

agentConfig.description: Path to agent-config.json (legacy/imported managed-agents-openai kits only).

createdAt.description: ISO date the kit was first created.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date of the last update to this manifest.
